Import Serial and Lot for Multiple Product in Picking-Receipt and Internal Transfer From Excel Odoo Apps

Don't you get irritated by importing lots of serial number while receiving product and deliver products. Don't you think its reduce your effective productivity to total time waste, importing serial number is import task for WMS must be done carefully , when orders are big on regular basis the whole process become super lengthy, so its defiantly take a toll on your efficiency. Import multiple-mass product serial and lot-Advance Odoo apps allow you import lot and serial number in bulk from vendor in incoming shipping and for customer in delivery order process, it will make whole process so simple less time consuming. This odoo app helps user to import bulk lot number and serial number for multiple product with name, code and barcode option in incoming shipment (Purchase) or internal transfer.

Import Lot Number and Serial Number for Multiple Product in Incoming Shipment(Purchases)

Data File Sample.

User have 3 different options to import lot/serial number for multiple product.

If you are using only numeric value for Internal ref or Barcode field then please make sure the cell type/format is Text/Character

Import with Name.

Import with Code.

Import with Barcode.

LOT
- Lot number for the product.
SERIAL NO
- Serial number for product.
QTY
- Quantity of product.
PRODUCT
- Name/Code/Barcode for product.

1. When "Name" is selected in "Import Product Based On" option, please select file that contains name of products.

2. When code is selected in "Import Product Based On" option, please select file that contains code of products.

3. When barcode is selected in "Import Product Based On" option, please select file that contains barcode of products.

Import Lot Number for Multiple Product in Incoming Shipment(Purchases)

Under Product > Inventory > Traceability set "Tracking" as "By Lots" to import product with lot number on incoming shipment.

User can import lot number for multiple product in incoming shipment by clicking "Import Lots/Serial No for Picking" button.

After click on button user can see new "Import Lot/Serial" wizard, Here user have to select file type, Lot No, upload file and option to import product based on, and click on "Import" button.

User can download sample file to import lot number for multiple product in picking-receipt by enable "Download Sample Files" option and select "Sample Type" as CSV or XLS and click "DOWNLOAD SAMPLE FILE" button on wizard.

After click on "Import" button user can see product's done quantity, and user can validate picking order.

After validate picking user can see imported lot number for product.
